newsitem.title: HONG KONG: PRESS DIGEST - HK Newspaper Headlines - Nov 5.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - HK Newspaper Headlines - Nov 5.

text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the Hong Kong press on Tuesday. Reuter has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
-- SOUTH CHINA MORNING POST -- Britain has protested to China over the alleged leak of details on talks about the stationing of an advance party of Chinese troops in Hong Kong ahead of the handover.
- The resurgence in the property market continued last month when the number of transactions more than doubled over those a year earlier.
-- HONG KONG COMMERCIAL DAILY -- The government will abolish rent controls on old buildings from January 1, next year. About 25,000 families will be affected by the decision.
-- APPLE DAILY - Police seized 4.9 kg of high-grade heroin and arrested three people in a Fanling Village house.
-- HONGKONG STANDARD -- The mother of leading Chinese dissident Wang Dan says she will sue the police authorities for illegally detaining her son for more than 17 months.
- The Stock Exchange of Hong Kong plans to review its present structure as part of a long term project but does not expect a major structural shake-up.
